addonClassName.en-US: Class name of the container wrapping the content.

addonId.zh-CN: addon 节点的 id，aria-labelledby 指向这个 id；未设置时随机生成。
addonId.en-US: Id of the addon node, which aria-labelledby points to. Generated when omitted.

addonStyle.zh-CN: 包裹内容容器的内联样式，只接受字符串。
addonStyle.en-US: Inline style of the container wrapping the content. Accepts a string only.

checked.zh-CN: 是否选中，可用 `bind:checked` 双向绑定；在 RadioGroup 中使用时无效。`bind:checked={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `checked` 时作为初值，点击在组件内覆盖，父级再传新值时以父级为准。
checked.en-US: Whether the radio is checked; bind it with `bind:checked`. Ignored inside a RadioGroup. `bind:checked={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `checked` is the initial value, a click overrides it inside the component, and a new value from the parent wins again.

children.zh-CN: Radio 的文本内容 snippet，写在标签内的其余内容就是它。
children.en-US: Label content snippet of the radio. The rest of the tag's content is this snippet.

displayMode.zh-CN: 设为 vertical 时 Radio 以块级元素独占一行。
displayMode.en-US: When set to vertical, the radio is displayed as a block and takes a line of its own.

extra.zh-CN: 辅助文本的 snippet，aria-describedby 指向它；type 为 button 时不渲染。
extra.en-US: Snippet of the supplementary text, which aria-describedby points to. Not rendered when type is button.

extraId.zh-CN: extra 节点的 id，aria-describedby 指向这个 id；未设置时随机生成。
extraId.en-US: Id of the extra node, which aria-describedby points to. Generated when omitted.

mode.zh-CN: 设为 advanced 时，已选中的 Radio 可以通过点击或空格取消选中；在 RadioGroup 中以组的 mode 为准。
mode.en-US: When set to advanced, a checked radio can be unchecked by clicking it or pressing Space. Inside a RadioGroup the group's mode applies.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中状态变化时的回调，参数的 `target` 为 `{ checked, value, name, disabled }`。
onChange.en-US: Called when the checked state changes. The event's `target` is `{ checked, value, name, disabled }`.

prefixCls.zh-CN: CSS 类名前缀，未设置时依次取所在 RadioGroup 的值与全局默认值。
prefixCls.en-US: CSS class name prefix. When omitted it falls back to the enclosing RadioGroup's value, then the global default.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动到该元素，作用于 focus 方法。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing prevents the browser from scrolling the element into view; applies to the focus method.

type.zh-CN: 样式类型，可选 default、button、card、pureCard；在 RadioGroup 中以组的 type 为准。
type.en-US: Style type: default, button, card or pureCard. Inside a RadioGroup the group's type applies.

value.zh-CN: Radio 的值，RadioGroup 据此判断是否选中；同时作为原生 input 的 value 参与表单提交。
value.en-US: The radio's value, which a RadioGroup compares to decide whether it is checked. It is also the native input's value in form submission.

focus.zh-CN: 使原生 input 获得焦点。

blur.zh-CN: 使原生 input 失去焦点。
blur.en-US: Removes focus from the native input.

buttonSize.zh-CN: type 为 button 时按钮的尺寸，可选 small、middle、large。
buttonSize.en-US: Button size when type is button: small, middle or large.

children.zh-CN: 组内的 Radio；设置 options 时忽略。
children.en-US: Radio components in the group. Ignored when options is set.

direction.zh-CN: 组内 Radio 的排列方向，可选 horizontal 或 vertical；type 为 button 时不支持。
direction.en-US: Layout direction of the radios: horizontal or vertical. Not supported when type is button.

disabled.en-US: Whether the whole group is disabled.

extra.zh-CN: 自定义 options 中每一项辅助文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
extra.en-US: Snippet for the extra text of each item in options, with the parameter `{ option, index }`.

label.zh-CN: 自定义 options 中每一项文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
label.en-US: Snippet for the label of each item in options, with the parameter `{ option, index }`.

mode.zh-CN: 设为 advanced 时，已选中的 Radio 可以通过点击或空格取消选中，此时选中值变为 undefined。
mode.en-US: When set to advanced, a checked radio can be unchecked by clicking it or pressing Space, and the selected value becomes undefined.

name.zh-CN: 组内所有原生 input 的 name；未设置时每组生成唯一值。
name.en-US: The name of every native input in the group. A unique value is generated per group when omitted.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个分组时的回调，在组内 Radio 之间移动焦点不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the whole group; moving focus between its radios does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中的值变化时的回调，参数的 `target.value` 为新的选中值；mode 为 advanced 且取消选中时为 undefined。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selected value changes. The event's `target.value` is the new value, or undefined when mode is advanced and the selected radio is unchecked.

options.zh-CN: 以配置形式声明选项，元素为字符串或 `{ label, value, disabled, extra, class, style, addonId, addonStyle, addonClass, extraId }`，其中 `style`、`addonStyle` 为字符串。
options.en-US: Declares the options as data. Each item is a string or `{ label, value, disabled, extra, class, style, addonId, addonStyle, addonClass, extraId }`, where `style` and `addonStyle` are strings.

type.zh-CN: 组内所有 Radio 的样式类型，可选 default、button、card、pureCard。
type.en-US: Style type of every Radio in the group: default, button, card or pureCard.

value.zh-CN: 选中的值，可用 `bind:value` 双向绑定，与 Radio 的 value 匹配。`bind:value={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `value` 时作为初值。
value.en-US: The selected value, matched against each Radio's value; bind it with `bind:value`. `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `value` is the initial value.
